normal_selection: ascending SHA256(protocol seed + dataset + category + relative image path), no Test input
normal_split: first half for spatial statistics, second half for operating thresholds
normal_fit_notice: The reused PCA was fitted on all normal training images, including both calibration partitions. This is not out-of-fit conformal calibration; thresholds have no guaranteed coverage. Test normal images are used only for evaluation.
score_dtype: float64, signed calibrated scores, no clipping
normal_extraction_device_preference: cuda, with CPU equivalence gate before accepting any GPU normal map

acceptance.acceptance_notice: Both dataset macros must satisfy image noninferiority and the same gain branch; category improvement and median consistency apply. These are exploratory engineering gates, not journal acceptance criteria.

novelty_notice: Normal calibration, spatial normalization, smoothing and shrinkage have precedents. This candidate is exploratory; no originality or SCI acceptance claim.
test_notice: These Test datasets were evaluated previously. Settings and acceptance gates are frozen before this new evaluation; this is not an unseen blind benchmark.
